blocks.name: All Notes Off
blocks.channel: n= MIDI channel number: 0H~FH (Ch.1~16)
notes: • This message is received at intervals of approximately 250 ms.
• Default MIDI channel is 15
• to receive Memory 1.1 send CC00=0, PG=0
• to receive Memory 4.2 send CC00=3, PG=1
• to receive Memory 1 send PG=0 (ONLY FOR VIVO S2)
• to receive Memory 80 send PG=79 (ONLY FOR VIVO S2)
• Not received when “Memory RX Status" is Off.
